preconditions.description: The number of strings k is between 1 and 26, inclusive.
The string q consists of lowercase Latin letters.
The length of the string q is between 1 and 100, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The first line of the output is either 'YES' or 'NO'.
If the output is 'YES', there are exactly k additional lines containing the beautiful sequence.
If the output is 'NO', there are no additional lines.

postconditions.expression: stdout.splitlines()[0] == 'YES' and len(set(s[0] for s in stdout.splitlines()[1:])) == len(stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', the first characters of the strings in the sequence are distinct.
If the output is 'YES', the concatenation of the strings in the sequence equals the input string q.
